summary: Fresh preview regression completed: backend critical flows passed and UI signup, login/logout, dashboard, mocked mail, CSV validation, and bulk completion were exercised.

ui_bugs.issue: The test-send button is not inside a form and its click handler bypasses HTML required validation. Clicking it with an empty recipient sends an invalid request and displays the generic error instead of a required-field message.

action_items: Validate campaign test recipient before invoking the API and show a field-level error for empty/invalid input.
Add stable key props to mapped Shell navigation links and dashboard campaign rows to remove the React console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Bulk campaign test-send validation relies on a required attribute that is bypassed because the button uses an onClick handler rather than form submission.
React list mappings in Shell and Dashboard omit key props, producing a console warning on every authenticated page render.
seed_data_creation: Created fresh temporary users and campaigns through public signup/API flows; no seeded data modified. Email delivery endpoints remain MOCKED by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression passed all 4 tests. UI valid bulk flow passed through COMPLETED, single/test mock mail passed, mobile dashboard loaded. Recheck empty campaign test recipient validation, React console warnings, and cross-user isolation if extended coverage is required.
rca of the issue: The campaign test recipient input has required/type=email, but the send button is outside a form and directly calls campaignTest; browser constraint validation therefore never runs. The API receives an empty value, returns 422, and errorText falls back to a generic message. React warnings originate from .map() calls rendering NavLink and campaign-row elements without key props.
